rationale: M=4 is exact but increasingly slow; M=32 is exact and fast through M=168 but reaches 1.79x on QKV M=256; M=256 is fast at large M but not invariant. Test the three natural strategies between M=32 and M=256 once, without manual tuning.
procedure: For each of the same two shapes and each source M, use a fresh discovery process, normalize the emitted verbose string exactly as R123a specifies, then use a fresh override process for the unchanged full R123 M and timing screen.

gates.correctness: All five R123 exactness checks must pass on both shapes.
gates.latency: For both shapes, geometric-mean candidate/control latency across M=1,4,32,168,256 must be <=1.15 and no individual point may exceed 1.50x.
gates.health: Stop immediately on any new Xe fault, reset, timeout, hang, coredump, or device loss.

terminal_rule: This is the final catalog-strategy interpolation search. If no candidate passes, do not widen the source-M sweep or hand-tune strategy strings.
